record.name: Squarespace
record.one_liner: Squarespace provides Commerce APIs, Reseller APIs, custom code tools, and webhooks for building external apps, managing storefronts, and reselling sites.

auth.notes: Squarespace supports both OAuth 2.0 (for extensions and commercial apps) and API keys (for custom applications on Commerce Advanced plans).

access.notes: Developers can generate API keys directly in the site settings (self-serve for custom applications) or register for OAuth client credentials, which historically required manual form submissions/tickets though a self-service OAuth model is being introduced.

api_surface.notes: Offers REST endpoints for Commerce APIs and Reseller APIs, plus webhooks with signed payloads for event delivery.

mcp.notes: The documentation mentions AI compatibility to integrate API docs into Claude or ChatGPT, but does not provide a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

buildability.reasoning: API keys can be generated self-serve for custom applications, and OAuth credential management is transitioning to self-service, but commercial extensions still require registration, reviews, and approval.
